exceptions.title: Freight basis inferred from 'FOR Bhiwandi' wording

exceptions.title: Vendor's PKG-code labels do not align with RFQ dimensions/ply/print spec on 21 of 22 quoted lines
exceptions.detail: Across nearly every quoted line, the vendor's stated dimensions/ply do not match the same-numbered RFQ line. Six lines are exact dimensional matches to a *different* RFQ code (PKG-004→RFQ PKG-003 dims; PKG-006→RFQ PKG-005 dims; PKG-013→RFQ PKG-015 dims; PKG-016→RFQ PKG-017 dims; PKG-020→RFQ PKG-022 dims; PKG-023→RFQ PKG-027 dims), suggesting the vendor's internal catalog numbering does not correspond 1:1 to this RFQ. The remaining mismatched lines have dimensions/ply that simply don't match the RFQ spec with no clear cross-reference. Applying these prices to the labeled RFQ lines as-is would be an unsafe inference given match_confidence ≤0.5 on every affected line.
options: Request a corrected quotation from the vendor mapped explicitly to RFQ PKG-001–PKG-030 codes, dimensions, and ply/print specs
Manually re-map the six identified cross-matched lines and treat the remaining mismatched lines as effectively unquoted pending vendor confirmation
Exclude this vendor from line-level scoring until a corrected quote is received
